scope: Read-only aggregation of the existing shell_gate_attempt2/fixed_stress.log and targeted inspection of its referenced physical_attempt2/gate_netlist.v; no simulation, synthesis, TD, training, RTL, netlist, or checker rerun/change.

observed_outcome.pass_marker: fixed_stress.log:103381 TB_PASS_RUNTIME_LAYER_SHELL tiles=3 exported=1152 guards=3 core_cycles=2607
observed_outcome.interpretation: The exercised gold workload passed. This is not evidence that the netlist is warning-free or that every optional/unexercised primitive mode is sound.

vsim-3016.message: Connected port has simulator type incompatibility

vopt-2958.message: Implicit open_n wire has no driver

vsim-2685.message: Elaboration-phase duplicate of the AL_MAP_LUT1 too-few-port warning

ph1p_phy_lslice_superset_interface.evidence: All expected-38 shapes are PH1P_PHY_LSLICE-style LUT/adder/ramread cells. Common omitted model ports include cea/ceb/asr/ssr/shift/carry/LUT outputs. Each of dpram_wclk, dpram_byteaddr, dpram_waddr, dpram_we, dpram_shiftmode, dpram_rammode, and dpram_width appears 1439 times.
ph1p_phy_lslice_superset_interface.classification: Vendor primitive model exposes a superset interface. The dpram_* names here belong to LSLICE cells and are not evidence that the separate SiLU ERAM data or write enable is disconnected.

al_map_seq_fixed_mux_ports.classification: The emitted cell parameters select constant CE/reset muxes where the corresponding runtime pin is omitted. These include bias pipeline registers; their d/q/clock/reset data paths remain present.

ph1p_dsp_siou_superset_interface.classification: Unused add/logic/ternary-add/carry outputs and controls from the DSP supercell interface are omitted. The listed missing ports do not include xa, y, mult_p, clk, inctrl, muxctrl, opctrl, or rst.

io_pad_superset_interfaces.classification: Input/output pad models omit unused delay, differential, scan, and opposite-direction ports according to configured pad mode.

single_port_silu_eram_configuration.classification: Unused B port, ECC, FIFO, cascade, probe, output-register reset/clock-enable features. Active A-side address, clock, chip select, data input, write enable, and data output are connected.

parameter_only_config_cell.classification: PH1P_PHY_CONFIG_V2 config_inst is emitted with parameters and empty parentheses.

constant_lut_input.classification: One AL_MAP_LUT1 constant cell omits input a; the too-few warning is reported once by vopt and once again by vsim.

implicit_open_control_bits.classification: Undriven open_n nets occur in DSP supercell control/config vectors, not in the named activation or weight operand nets. They are not blanket-waived: they remain a vendor-netlist/simulation-model fidelity risk for unexercised configurations.

connected_port_type_mismatches.classification: These warnings identify an incompatible connected type, not an absent connection. They remain a simulator-model fidelity issue even though the fixed workload passed.

mac_operands.finding: No explicit missing active operand connection found.
evidence: gate_netlist.v:111307-111315 road_mac_probe DSP supercell has clk, inctrl, mult_p, muxctrl, opctrl, rst, xa=reg_activation_front_b, and y=reg_weight_front_b connected.
The DSP missing-port bucket contains unused add/logic/ternary/carry interface fields, not xa or y.
The 408 road_mac_probe open_n warnings are control/config-vector positions; they are a residual model-fidelity risk, not evidence that activation or weight operands are absent.

mac_bias.finding: No explicit missing bias data path found.
evidence: gate_netlist.v:118421-118424 drives reg_bias_front_b[0] from flag_mac_input_accept and reg_mac_bias[0].
gate_netlist.v:116002-116007 feeds candidate_beta_sum[22] into the beta accumulator register.
candidate road_mac_probe.v:205-214 uses reg_bias_dot as the first-dot base and adds the dot product; lines 449-470 commit candidate sums.
mac_bias.warning_interpretation: Bias-register too-few warnings are omitted CE pins where CEMUX is fixed, not missing d/q bias data.

silu_eram_data_and_enable.finding: No explicit missing active A-side ERAM data or write-enable connection found.
evidence: gate_netlist.v:192882-192889 connects addra, clka, csa[2]=flag_pipeline_enable, dia, dia_extra, wea=flag_table_write_enable, doa, and doa_extra.
The 27 omitted ERAM ports are the unused B side and optional ECC/FIFO/cascade/probe/output-register controls listed above.
silu_eram_data_and_enable.warning_interpretation: The 1439 dpram_we warnings are PH1P_PHY_LSLICE superset pins, not the SiLU PH1P_LOGIC_ERAM wea connection.

residual_risks: The passing fixed workload does not cover every primitive mode or future vector
closure_decision.minimum_close_path: Keep the functional PASS as workload evidence, but close simulator fidelity separately with the exact vendor primitive library/netlist pairing or regenerated vendor netlist, then require code-count deltas plus the same gold cases. Do not alter MAC arithmetic, latency, handshake, or ERAM protocol merely to suppress these warnings.
closure_decision.extra_authorization: Read-only triage needs none. Changing vendor libraries/netlist generation or rerunning external tools requires the parent workflow's explicit authorization.
